text.description_html:
Laurey 74677, Aventura Venetian Bronze Cabinet Pull

The Small Venetian Bronze Aventura Cabinet Pull is made out of zinc. This cabinet handle is a great choice for any home remodel project. The Venetian Bronze finish is stunning. The Aventura Venetian Bronze Cabinet Pull comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Aventura Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 74677 96mm Pull Aventura Venetian Bronze:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Venetian Bronze
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3-3/4" (96mm)
  • Overall Length: 4"
  • Width: 1/2"
  • Projection: 7/8"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
